item.title: Understanding the Root Cause of CVE-2026-119618
item.description: Investigating CVE-2026-119618 Recently, Apache released an advisory for CVE-2026-119618, an improper synchronization vulnerability in mod_http2 that causes heap corruption and, according to Apache, can lead to remote code execution. As soon as it was disclosed, we began analyzing the vulnerability to better understand the root cause and to build scanners and detections to identify vulnerable […] The post Understanding the Root Cause of CVE-2026-119618 appeared first on Praetorian .

item.title: Fastly、日本で定額WAFパッケージを提供。中小企業のセキュリティ支援へ
item.description: クラウドエッジプラットフォームを提供するファストリ―株式会社（Fastly）は11月19日、記者説明会を実施し、エッジプラットフォームのAIサービスへの拡大と、日本における中小企業向けセキュリティパッケージの提供を発表した。

item.title: Rackspace shuts down Spot cloud platform after security breach

item.title: How Penetration Testing Strengthens Your Cyber Insurance Renewal Strategy
item.description: Cyber insurance renewals have changed, have you noticed? Insurers are asking more questions, and those questions are growing more pointed. They want to understand not just what security controls you have on paper, but also how those controls work in practice. More than that, insurers want to see evidence of your vulnerability management, testing, remediation, and overall security maturity.
